name: Guided Pause
description: A short run of timed steps, one at a time, with a small picture and a gentle progress bar. Install a pause pack to choose the steps. Your place is saved.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: A short run of timed steps, shown one at a time. The steps come from a pause pack.
help.goal: There is nothing to finish. Follow the steps you like, skip the ones you do not, and stop whenever you want.
howToPlay: Press Begin when you are ready. Each step shows for a few seconds, then the next one appears.
Press Next to skip ahead, or Back to return to the start of a step.
Press Pause to stop the timer, then Continue to pick up where you were.
At the end you can press Restart to go round again.

controls.action: Move between Back, Next, Begin and Restart

tips: Skip any step that does not suit you, and stop if anything feels uncomfortable.
Your place is saved, so a pause can be as short as one step.
These are small ideas for a break, not advice.
